configRWG.WORLDGEN_WARNING: Changing this after creating a world causes borders between old and new chunks.
configRWG.OFFSET_WARNING: Expert migration setting. Change only before generating new chunks. Positive values sample the generator at larger coordinates, moving the corresponding map features toward negative coordinates.
configRWG.CONTINENT_WIDTH: Distance in blocks from a continent's Voronoi centre to its coast. Changing this after creating a world causes borders between old and new chunks.
configRWG.ISLAND_WIDTH: Distance in blocks from an island seed to its coast. Changing this after creating a world causes borders between old and new chunks.
